'''Halkra''', also known as "'''strangle vines'''," was an arboreal predator from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. 
==Habitat and appearance==
The creatures lived with the planet's forests and were easily disguised by their environment among the trees. Within the forest, they appeared as normal vines, covered in lichens, often tangled-looking, and hanging from low branches near sources of [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

Their skin had a bark-like structure complete with wrinkles and cracks that allowed moss and seedlings to grow on it, camouflaging it perfectly among natural tree logs.<ref name="guide" />

It usually hid near waterholes or grazing spots and fed on smaller predators (it ignored herbivores) and laid its traps thanks to its long tentacles.<ref name="guide" />
==Anatomy==
The plant had a toothless maw and a head right above it that looked like an armored ridge.<ref name="guide" />

Around its body were eight olfactory slits and four multi-faceted [[eye/Legends|eyes]] that sensed for prey in every direction; the eyes were incapable to see during the night, and were ultra-sensitive to light.<ref name="guide" />

It has twelve tentacles eight meters long which provided locomotion and also set the "trap" to capture the prey; they caused vegetation to shake and lure small predators, then ensnared them, crushing or strangling them, then digest it within a central sac of powerful [[acid/Legends|acids]]. A [[humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], such as a Bothan, could be digested within 36 [[standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="guide" />
